children: Canada security solutions firm's fiscal Q2 revenue rose yr/yr to C$10 mln
Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal Q2 grew 41% yr/yr to C$0.8 mln
Company attributes growth to higher MAST deployments and expansion of AI-powered services
Company did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for future periods in its press release
MAST DEPLOYMENTS - Co said increased deployment of MAST and MASTc security units, including first international deployments in Greece, contributed to revenue growth
AI-POWERED SERVICES - Co said expansion of AI-powered gun detection network to additional US schools and launch of TESEUM platform supported growth
GROSS MARGIN IMPROVEMENT - Co attributed higher gross margin to operational streamlining and strong collections on accounts receivable
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the business support services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Avante Corp is C$2.75, about 71.9% above its November 20 closing price of C$1.60
